Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Two long-term friends just had a falling out, a brother of mine and a person with autism. I went to talk to each of them about it. The brother of mine wasn't willing to talk about it at all and just wanted me to leave, while the person with autism mentioned being really sad because they liked having such a close connection with someone. Who talked about their emotions?
A. The brother
B. Cannot answer
C. The person with autism
